hard_deny: Never run git push in any form (wrappers such as bash -c, absolute paths, aliases, scripts, or variables included). The user pushes and merges branches themselves.
Never create a git commit or pull request whose message carries AI attribution: a Co-Authored-By trailer naming an AI, a 'Generated with' line, a Claude-Session trailer, or a claude.ai session link.
Never bypass git hooks: no --no-verify, no -n on git commit, no core.hooksPath override, and no SKIP= or HUSKY= environment override.
